user_request_ru: Имба, давай его разработаем, да и думаю места под ресурсы там должно быть не мало, а красивые дизайны я люблю))
intent: Develop a visually distinctive, spacious cargo expedition catamaran for EREZCRAFT's lower toxic sea, using the established block-based Create/Sable direction.
scope: Concept, editable game art model, measured interior layout, proposed modular storage and integration specification. No publication or server changes.
style: long stepped bows and sloped bridge matching the original concept

requirements.text: Two visibly separate hulls and bow channel
24 modeled cargo drawers in two banks, six bays and two tiers
requirements.verification: Source and saved-scene counts; cutaway render

requirements.text: Continuous central aisle at least 2.5 blocks wide and 2 blocks clear high; stairs in a separate aft bay
requirements.verification: Saved-scene AABB exclusion against declared aisle; visual cutaway

requirements.text: Forward two-seat cabin, two air propeller assemblies, aft folded crane
Editable local source, packed Blender scene and self-contained GLB
Existing verified CC0 texture pixels changed by RGB palette only
requirements.verification: Hash, color mapping, alpha and dimension checks

requirements.text: Separate visual design from working Minecraft transport
requirements.verification: Readme, source metadata and integration specification

capacity_assumption: 24 custom cargo modules x 54 slots = 1296 target slots; 82944 items only if every slot holds a full 64-stack. Drawers are modeled art, not implemented inventories.
unknowns: Sable buoyancy for the two custom Interstice fluid types
actual simulated mass and center of mass
passenger shelter and toxin exposure while moving
multiplayer boarding, chunk reload and server performance
units: Minecraft blocks, one Blender unit per block. No real material density, loads or manufacturing tolerances are assumed.
source_of_parameters: User direction, prior agreed Skat concept, local game dimension and visual layout choices. All dimensions are editable game-design choices.
owner_correction_ru: Первая модель слишком далеко ушла от первоначального концепта. Владелец предпочитает реализм и просит сохранить обещанное качество внешности. SK02 пересобрана по исходной картинке. Последующим прямым поручением владелец попросил сохранить обе версии: маленький SK01 и большой SK02, включая показанные рендеры.
